newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Fortune 500 companies upbeat on Latin America.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Fortune 500 companies upbeat on Latin America.

text.p: Price Waterhouse, a leading U.S. accounting firm, said a survey of the 500 largest U.S. corporations showed an overwhelming majority intend to invest in the region.
Ninety-eight percent of the respondents stated that their own companies would be making new or additional investments in the region within the next three years, it said.
Nearly 90 percent of the participating executives said that the new economic policies in Brazil and Argentina encourage U.S. investment in those countries.

Regarding the most important issues affecting companies' decisions to make additional investments in Argentina, 57 percent said "political stability"; 50 percent "economic growth rate"; 48 percent "regulatory environment"; and 47 percent "devaluation."

For Brazil, 60 percent of the respondents cited "devaluation"; 60 percent "political stability"; and 57 percent "regulatory environment" as the most important issues in making the investment decision.
